text:
alexa: pushed updated policy studio mock — compact header that collapses on scroll, denser rule tokens, and a disabled preview overlay when validation errors exist. need quick checks: token contrast at 14px, keyboard focus clipping under header, and microcopy for the preview-disabled state. figma: https://figma.mock/policy-studio

ben: :eyes: nice and tighter. main issue I saw: header is ~68px expanded and hides the first rule when tabbing. can we collapse to ~36px when keyboard focus enters the rules list?

rita: ran automated contrast: chip bg #F4F7FB with text #111827 = 3.8:1 at 14px. fails WCAG. option A: darken text to #07101A (~4.6:1) which keeps palette; option B: change bg to #E8EEF5. prefer darkening text to maintain tokens and density.

alex: agree — darken text to keep spacing. also let's avoid increasing font-size.

sam: preview behavior thought: instead of a blocking modal, disable the preview toggle, dim the preview pane, and surface a small inline banner that says "Resolve rule issues to enable preview." add role="status" aria-live="polite" for the banner and set aria-hidden on the preview region when overlay is active.

ben: keyboard/nav edge: prefer auto-scrolling focused rule into view with scroll-margin-top equal to header height rather than collapsing header, so pointer users don't get a janky layout shift. trigger that only for keyboard focus (focus-visible).

rita: copy tweak: change any instance of "Fix rules to preview" -> "Resolve rule issues to enable preview"  clearer for screen readers and less imperative. also add an i18n key: preview.disabled.resolve_rules = "Resolve rule issues to enable preview".

alexa: decision recap: chip text -> #07101A at 14px; visible focus ring: outline 2px solid #2563EB with outline-offset 2px; implement scroll-margin-top on :focus-visible to keep focused item visible; preview toggle disabled when there are validation errors with dim + inline banner copy per rita; aria-live polite for updates and aria-hidden on preview when overlay active.

sam/rita: please open PR with CSS token change, aria updates, i18n key, and visual-regression screenshots for normal and overlay states. include a small keyboard e2e that verifies focus scrolls into view.

ci-bot: visual-regression job queued for branch rita/compact-header-preview. will post results when complete.

alexa: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
